O you who are wrapped in a cloak.
Get up and warn people.
And say that your Lord is the Greatest.
And keep your clothes clean.
And stay away from dirty and bad things.
And do not give just to get more.
And be patient for your Lord.
When the horn is blown.
That Day will be a hard day.
For the people who said no, it will not be easy.
Leave Me with the one I made alone.
And I gave him a lot of money.
And children who were with him.
And I made things easy for him.
Then he wants Me to give him even more!
No! He was against Our verses.
I will make it harder and harder for him.
He thought and planned.
May he be ruined, how he planned!
Again, may he be ruined, how he planned!
Then he looked.
Then he frowned and made a sour face.
Then he turned back and was proud.
And he said: This is only magic from old times.
This is only the words of a human.
I will burn him in Saqar, a place in Hell.
What can make you know what Saqar is?
It does not leave anything and does not spare anything.
It burns the skin.
There are nineteen over it.

We made only angels the guards of the Fire. We made their number a test for people who said no. It makes people who were given a book sure, and makes believers have more faith. It makes sure the people with the book and the believers have no doubt. But people with sickness in their hearts and people who said no will say: What did Allah mean by this? So Allah lets go astray whom He wants and guides whom He wants. No one knows the armies of your Lord but Him. This is only a reminder for people.
No! By the moon.
And by the night when it goes away.
And by the morning when it lights up.
It is one of the biggest things.
A warning to people.
To whoever of you wants to go forward or stay behind.
Every person is held for what he earned.
Except the people of the right side.
They are in gardens, asking.
About the people who did wrong.
What put you into Saqar?
They will say: We were not people who prayed.
And we did not feed the poor.
And we joined in with people who talked nonsense.
And we used to say the Day of Judgment was not true.
Until the sure thing came to us.
The help of people who speak up for them will not help them.
Why do they turn away from the reminder?
As if they were scared donkeys.
Running away from a lion?
But each of them wants to be given pages opened up.
No! But they do not fear the next life.
No, it is a reminder.
So whoever wants to, will remember it.
But they will not remember unless Allah wants. He is the One to be feared, and the One who forgives.
